verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee offers markdown output (return_page_markdown), AI-driven extraction (ai_query), and structured extraction (extract_rules) which can produce citable, structured output usable by research agents, plus an MCP server for agentic integration. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated 'preset configuration tuned for research agents' — no named research-agent mode, no citation metadata, and no documentation bundling these features into a single agent-oriented preset. missing for 10: a documented research-agent preset/mode, citation/source-attribution output, and evidence of agent-specific tuning beyond generic AI extraction params.
